quotes.text: to think of the vocation of the church as the call to live as the small working model of new creation.
We live in the present as the new creation in miniature, the advance working model of what God intends to do in the end.

in assembling there on that occasion, they furnished an emblem of the millennial state of the Church, nay, an emblem of the heavenly state, when men of different nations, and known by different names, should sit down together in the kingdom of God.
The kingdom of heaven is divided into small societies, called churches or congregations of the Lord.
the church, their temple; the Saviour is their altar; their songs, their praises, are incense ascending to heaven
Are they called citizens? — the church is then the kingdom of heaven.
Ephesians is all about the church, and especially about its unity
the coming together of Judaean and Gentile in the Messiah’s family is the remarkable and powerful sign of that in the present.
a kind of ‘seven spiritual laws’: one body, one spirit, one hope; one lord, one faith, one baptism; and, above all, one God.
We will, that this body die, be dissolved, and sink into union with the Body of Christ at large; for there is but one body, and one Spirit, even as we are called in one hope of our calling.
this term cannot serve as an excuse for disunity on the ground. Paul would be shocked by the very idea of ‘denominations’, sitting close to one another on the same street
The present state of the church shews many bodies, many heads and many law-givers. Can they all be the church of Christ? Impossible, if judged according to the Scriptures.
we must constantly be looking for ways to make our God-given unity a reality in visible practice and mutual love.
yet but one visible community, having one Lord, one faith, one baptism, one table, one ostensible supreme and all-controlling interest
The principalities and powers always tend toward a monochrome, drab uniformity, squashing everything into the same shape and dealing violently with the bits that refuse to conform.
is made the bond of union; and a difference in the tenth or ten-thousandth shade of opinion frequently becomes the actual cause of dismemberment or expulsion.
the thing to be forborne being a matter of private opinion
whereas we are expressly commanded to endeavor to maintain the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
not altogether in a union of opinion; for this is unattainable, if desirable in the present imperfect state of man: but they lived in a union of spirit.
The Eucharist, as many theologians have seen, defines the church: ‘There is one loaf; well, then, there may be several of us, but we are one body, because we all share the one loaf.’
We are presented, close up and personally, with new creation that we can eat and drink.
You, my brother, once an alien, are now a citizen of heaven; once a stranger, are now brought home to the family of God
Under Jesus the Messiah we are one
we shall jointly suffer with him, that we may jointly reign with him.
what ‘being filled with the spirit’ looks like (anticipating, we recall, God’s filling of all creation) is a life of music and thanksgiving, of delight that turns into song
We all engaged in singing the same songs of praise—all united in prayer—all preached the same things

The ground is even at the foot of the cross. But those who stand on that even ground—and together sing their hearts out in joy and gratitude—are, and remain, a community drawn from every nation, people, tribe, and tongue.
Reading scripture, like praying and sharing in the sacraments, is one of the means by which the life of heaven and the life of earth interlock.
hearing God’s voice in scripture isn’t simply a matter of precise, technical expertise. It’s a matter of love
as it respects God, there is an understanding distance. All beyond that distance cannot understand God
God himself is the centre of that circle, and humility is its circumference.
To the intent that now unto the principalities and powers in heavenly places might be known by the church the manifold wisdom of God.

the church is designed, intended—and equipped by the spirit!—to display the multicolored reality of God’s original creation, as the signpost to the principalities and powers that think they run the world.

An organized society of this kind, modelled after the plan taught in the New Testament, is the consummation of the manifold wisdom of God to exhibit to the world the civilizing, the moralizing, the saving light
That community life has always startled outsiders, provoking some to fierce opposition but convincing many (including former persecutors) of the truth of the gospel.
This gracious unity and unanimity in Jesus would afford the best external evidence of their union with him, and of their conjoint interest in the Father’s love.
Where, O Where is this church or kingdom, in which these things are, and which is thus shining! We long to see it—We long to see the world, attracted by her light, flowing to her
to suppose that all christians will form one communion in that happy age of the world, and not before it, is to suppose a moral effect without a cause.
